name: ring skin the cat
description: A gymnastic move where you rotate backward through the rings. It builds shoulder mobility and control.
instructions: Hang from the rings with a firm grip.
Tuck your knees and lift your hips overhead.
Rotate backward, passing your legs between your arms.
Lower your feet toward the floor until you stretch your shoulders.
Pause, then reverse the motion with control.
Move slowly and stop if you feel pinching.
